title: Working with Heavy Equipment
cross_references: NWCG Standards for Wildfire Resource Typing, PMS 200

nodes.text: Stay at least 100 feet in front and 50 feet behind heavy equipment. In timber, increase distance to 2 times the canopy height

evidence.source_text: When working around heavy equipment, stay at least 100 feet in front and 50 feet behind the equipment. In timber, distances should be increased to 2 times the canopy height.

nodes.text: No one but the operator should ride on the equipment

evidence.source_text: No one but the operator should ride on the equipment.

nodes.text: Never approach equipment until you have eye contact with the operator, all implements have been lowered to the ground, and equipment is idled down

evidence.source_text: Never approach equipment until you have eye contact with the operator, all implements have been lowered to the ground, and equipment is idled down.

nodes.text: Avoid working downhill from equipment where rolling material could jeopardize your safety

evidence.source_text: Avoid working downhill from equipment where rolling material could jeopardize your safety.

nodes.text: Night work is more dangerous due to reduced visibility. Use headlamp and/or glow sticks so the operator can see you

evidence.source_text: Night work is more dangerous due to reduced visibility. Use headlamp and/or glow sticks so the operator can see you.

nodes.text: Establish visual and radio communication methods prior to engaging

evidence.source_text: Establish visual and radio communication methods prior to engaging.

nodes.text: Communicate all hazards to the operator (spot fires, firing operations, and obstacles)

evidence.source_text: Communicate all hazards to the operator (spot fires, firing operations, and obstacles).

nodes.text: Equipment operators have difficulty seeing ground personnel; take responsibility for your safety and all those around you

evidence.source_text: Equipment operators have difficulty seeing ground personnel; take responsibility for your safety and all those around you.

nodes.text: End of Working with Heavy Equipment protocol
